plan.title: Record the host and clone inventory
verification: Compare the recorded head and working-tree state with the captured output of `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git status --porcelain=v2 --branch`.
Compare the recorded remote heads with `git ls-remote --heads origin`.
Re-read the record and confirm that no listed item is blank.

plan.title: Create the migration task record, branch and worktree
verification: Run `python3 tools/chat_workflow.py check` in the migration worktree.
Confirm that `git merge-base` of the migration branch and main equals the recorded starting revision.
Compare the SHA-256 of the committed TRD file with the approved revision's SHA-256.
Confirm with `git worktree list` and `git ls-remote --heads origin` that the worktree exists and the C271 branch head is unchanged.

plan.title: Record the dated owner-direction decision
verification: Read the record against the acceptance criteria of REQ-016.
Run the documentation verifier and confirm that the record's links resolve.

plan.title: Capture the identities that must be preserved
verification: Recompute each digest in the migration worktree and compare it with the record.
Compare the recorded C271 head with `git ls-remote --heads origin` and the recorded states with `gh pr view 274` and `gh issue view 273`.

plan.title: Reconcile the Git-visible state of main, C271 and the local clone
verification: Compare the recorded heads with `git ls-remote --heads origin` and the recorded pull-request state with `gh pr view 274`.
Confirm with `git log main..HEAD` that the migration branch contains no commit from the C271 branch.

plan.title: Verify the R06 handoff and its receipt before any import
verification: Run `shasum -a 256` on the outer archive and compare the result with the identity recorded in the TRD.
Compute the Git blob identity of the evidence member with `git hash-object` without writing it to the object store.
Run `git status --porcelain` in the clone before and after and confirm that nothing changed.

plan.title: Complete the reconciliation record from the verified handoff
verification: Compare `git status --porcelain` and the tracked-file list of the migration worktree before and after the extraction.
Check each item claimed as unique against `git ls-tree -r` of main and of the C271 branch.

plan.title: Record storage classes, durable locations and the restore check
verification: Check each recorded durable location by a read-only observation of that location.
Confirm with `git status --porcelain` that no environment, cache or archive was added to tracked files.

plan.title: Define the tracked environment specification, profiles and ignore rules
verification: Parse the specification with the standard library and compare its pins with `tools/force-agent-verification-requirements.txt` and the Linux lock.
Run `git check-ignore -v` on a `.venv` path, a worktree path and a local-configuration path, and confirm that the specification is not ignored.
Run `git diff --stat` and confirm that no unrelated ignore rule changed.

plan.title: Produce and review the macOS arm64 verification lock
verification: Recompute `shasum -a 256` for each staged wheel and compare it with the lock and the provenance record.
Compare the lock's set of versions with the Linux lock's set of versions.
Compare the SHA-256 of the Linux lock with the identity in `PRESERVATION.json`.

plan.title: Implement the bootstrap tool and its tests
verification: Run `python -m unittest tests.test_bootstrap_local -v` with the selected interpreter.
Run the tool's preview for `python-verification` and compare the file system before and after.
Inspect the code paths for the visual profile and for any install or network call outside an explicit non-preview run.

plan.title: Implement the doctor tool and its tests
verification: Run `python -m unittest tests.test_doctor_local -v`.
Run the doctor with an interpreter outside any environment and confirm that it reports `missing` rather than failing.
Compare `git status --porcelain` and the environment's package list before and after a doctor run.

plan.title: Create the default environment and reach python-verification readiness
verification: Run `.venv/bin/python -m pip check` and `.venv/bin/python -I -B tools/check_native_reader_setup.py`.
Run `.venv/bin/python -m ontokin capabilities` and `.venv/bin/python -m ontokin check docs/language-design/core-v0.1/01-independent-parts.ok`.
Run the bootstrap again and the doctor with JSON output, and compare the package list before and after.
Run `git status --porcelain` in the worktree.

plan.title: Prove installed-package behaviour outside the checkout
verification: Run the installed `ontokin capabilities` and `ontokin check` with an absolute path from a directory outside the checkout, with `PYTHONPATH` unset.
Print the import location of the `ontokin` package and of its payload module and compare them with the clean environment's site-packages directory.
Compare the SHA-256 of the wheel with the record.

plan.title: Record the routine-driver baseline on the unmodified base revision
verification: Run `tools/check_local.py` against the base revision with the environment's interpreter, an explicit `--timeout` and an `--output-dir` that is a new directory outside the checkout, and read each step report as well as the summary.
Run `docs/maintenance/reorganization-2026-10-17/verify_reorganization.py` and `tools/chat_workflow.py check` in place on the base revision.
Confirm with `git status --porcelain` that the base checkout is unchanged after the run.

plan.title: Write the local setup guide
verification: Execute each documented `python-verification` command in the migration worktree and compare the output with the guide.
Run the documentation verifier and confirm that the guide's links resolve.
Search the guide for `--with-deps` and for instructions that depend on uv or Conda and confirm there are none.

plan.title: Amend AGENTS.md and OK-ENG-006 for execution modes and local validation
verification: Read the amended files against REQ-016, REQ-017, REQ-018 and REQ-037.
Run the documentation verifier.
Run `git diff` on both files and confirm that the hosted-CI and preservation sections changed only where a mode qualifier was added.

plan.title: Amend the workflow protocol, handoff contract and workflow guide for local mode
verification: Read the three files against the acceptance criteria of REQ-017, REQ-025 and REQ-035.
Run the documentation verifier and `tools/chat_workflow.py check`.
Search the three files for statements that apply a browser-only rule to every session.

plan.title: Add the local entry document and the local prompts
verification: Compare the entry document with REQ-023 and REQ-024 step by step.
Run the doctor command exactly as the entry document gives it.
Run the documentation verifier.

plan.title: Add the Claude adapter
verification: Read `CLAUDE.md` and confirm that it holds only the import, the pointer and Claude-specific notes.
Search it for rule text that also appears in `AGENTS.md`.

plan.title: Route both modes in the registry, the root README and the documentation guide
verification: Run the documentation verifier.
Load the registry with the standard library and confirm that both read sets name files that exist.

plan.title: Amend the OntoKin session and delivery skills for local mode
verification: Run `tools/chat_workflow.py check`.
List `.claude/skills` and resolve each link.
Search the repository for a second `SKILL.md` that carries either skill name.

plan.title: Extend the session checkpoint template
verification: Compare the template with REQ-026 group by group.
Compare it with `docs/workflow/tasks/C270/SESSION.md` and confirm that the earlier record still fits.
Run the documentation verifier.

plan.title: Reconcile STATUS.md and compact CURRENT.json with provenance
verification: Compare the SHA-256 of the preserved earlier `CURRENT.json` with the identity of the file at the base revision.
Run the documentation verifier.
Run `git diff` on `STATUS.md` and confirm that the anchor lines are unchanged.

plan.title: Amend the workflow tool and its tests
verification: Run `python -m unittest tests.test_chat_workflow -v`.
Run `tools/chat_workflow.py check` and `tools/chat_workflow.py brief --json`.
Create a task in a temporary copy whose head has moved and read its `base_sha`.

plan.title: Amend the local driver's inventories and its tests
verification: Run `python -m unittest tests.test_local_checks -v`.
Run `tools/check_local.py --list` and one driver run with output outside the checkout, then read the `documents` step report.
Run `git diff --stat` and confirm that no file under an evidence directory changed.

plan.title: Run the changed-scope checks on the candidate and compare with the baseline
verification: Run `tools/check_local.py` with the environment's interpreter, an explicit `--timeout` and an `--output-dir` that is a new directory outside the checkout, and read each step report.
Run `docs/maintenance/reorganization-2026-10-17/verify_reorganization.py` and `tools/chat_workflow.py check`.
Run `python -m unittest tests.test_bootstrap_local tests.test_doctor_local tests.test_chat_workflow tests.test_local_checks -v`.
Compare `.github/workflows` with the base revision using `git diff`.

plan.title: Test a second worktree for recreation from specifications and for isolation
verification: Run the doctor with JSON output in both worktrees and compare the interpreter path, the environment path and the checkout root.
Compare each worktree's `git status --porcelain` and environment package list before and after the test.
Confirm from the creation records that no `.venv` was copied.

plan.title: Close a session with a checkpoint under the extended template
verification: Compare the checkpoint's source and verification fields with `git log`, `git status` and the candidate check record.
Run `tools/chat_workflow.py check`.

plan.title: Demonstrate fresh-session resumption in the owner's graphical workflow
verification: Compare the session's stated task, gate and next action with `docs/workflow/CURRENT.json`, the task record and the session checkpoint.
Record the application's reported version and the instruction files it loaded, as reported by the session itself.
Confirm that the session used no content from the prior conversation.

plan.title: Audit the candidate against every requirement and freeze it
verification: Walk the 42 requirements against the migration branch's diff from the base revision.
Search the candidate for `uv.lock`, `Dockerfile`, a compose file, a root `requirements.txt` and `TODO.md`.
Run the doctor with JSON output and copy the per-profile readiness into the audit.

plan.title: Obtain independent review of the exact candidate
verification: Compare the candidate commit named in the review with the frozen commit and with the final merge parent.
Check each mandatory finding against the commit that resolved it.

plan.title: Integrate into main and verify the resulting main
verification: Compare the main head from `git ls-remote --heads origin` with the recorded merge commit.
Run the documentation verifier, the workflow check and the routine driver on the resulting main and compare the results with the candidate results.
Read the pull request's merge state with `gh pr view`.

plan.title: Verify preservation and clean up the migration branch and worktrees
verification: Recompute the preserved digests on the resulting main and compare them with `PRESERVATION.json`.
Run `git ls-remote --heads origin` and `gh pr view 274` and compare the output with the recorded C271 identities.
Run `git worktree list` and `git status --porcelain` in each worktree before removal.

plan.title: Prepare the main checkout's environment from the integrated specifications
verification: Run the bootstrap and then the doctor with JSON output in the main checkout.
Run `.venv/bin/python -m pip check` and `.venv/bin/python -m ontokin capabilities` in the main checkout.
Run `git status --porcelain` and confirm that the environment is ignored.

plan.title: Publish the closing report and close the task record
verification: Run `tools/chat_workflow.py check` and the documentation verifier on main after the closing commit.
Compare the report's readiness section with a fresh doctor run in the main checkout.
Read the lease section of `STATUS.md` and the state of the scope issue.
